shot.camera_movement: slow creeping dolly-in toward the cup, mimicking the Stranger Things title reveal style

scene.location: dimly lit indoor space resembling an eerie, quiet room
scene.environment: Shadows stretch unnaturally across the background. The room lighting flickers subtly, as if affected by an unseen Upside Down force. A faint reddish-blue haze begins forming behind the cup.

cinematography.lighting: moody, low-contrast neon red and deep blue highlights inspired by Stranger Things. Soft flickering light pulses from overhead, creating supernatural tension.
cinematography.style: 80s retro horror with slow movements, atmospheric distortion, and slight grainy texture
cinematography.texture: matte ceramic texture on the cup, misty condensation on the upper rim, and soft reflections on the table surface
cinematography.depth_of_field: shallow focus on the cup, with the background gradually blurring into dark, upside-down fog

objects: A glass cup of tea sitting on a table, subtly vibrating as if reacting to supernatural presence.
positioning: The cup is centered in the frame, dominating the foreground while the dark, distorted background looms ominously behind.
text_elements: Text: 'GURGAON' appears in a Stranger Things–style glowing red neon font with a faint flicker. It fades in at a normal speed, holding in the center before zooming in at extremely high speed until it fills every pixel of the frame before vanishing.

motion: The video begins with a close-up of the tea cup. The camera slowly creeps forward. The lights flicker, and a low rumble vibrates through the room. The tea inside the cup ripples unnaturally, reacting to an unseen force, as a thin layer of fog gathers around the cup’s base. The background darkens into eerie Upside Down mist, while faint whispers echo subtly. Suddenly, glowing red text—'GURGAON'—fades in with supernatural energy. After a short flicker, it zooms forward at extreme speed, filling the screen entirely before disappearing into darkness.
